children: Brightline Interactive entered into securities purchase agreements with investors to sell 1,785,711 units at $0.70 per unit, each consisting of one common share and a warrant exercisable at $2.00. The company expects gross proceeds of $1.25 million, to be used for growth initiatives and working capital, with closing anticipated on Sep 25, 2026. The warrants are immediately exercisable, carry a five-year term, and include customary adjustments, including for an 8-for-1 stock split effective Sep 28, 2026.
